column1: #mapping_set_description: 'NCBI Datasets v2 genome assembly data report: one JSON object per assembly. Served by GET /genome/accession/{accessions}/dataset_report as a page {reports:[...], total_count}, and inside downloaded data packages as ncbi_dataset/data/assembly_data_report.jsonl (JSON Lines, camelCase keys). Native records here flatten nested objects to dotted snake_case paths; arrays stay whole.'
